method: Read public Steam English store HTML directly with Invoke-WebRequest; extract the first two user_reviews_summary_row anchors. Core game and multiplayer claims were checked against official Steam Features and About This Game sections. No purchases or installation performed.

metric_notes.english_all: Steam store English Reviews lifetime positive percentage and review count, not all-language totals or sales.
metric_notes.recent: Steam store Recent Reviews, displayed as last 30 days. The extracted top-row tooltip did not explicitly identify its language scope; do not label it English or all-language without an additional source.
metric_notes.comparability: Percentages are rounded Steam display values. Games differ in release age. Reviews are not unique player counts or sales, and this shortlist is not an exhaustive Steam ranking.
